entries.instruction: Grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom and the cylindrical plastic bottle for carrying water at the same time.
Pick up the bottle with ridged neck and take the medium bottle together.
Pick up the hand-sized bottle with ridged bottom and the liquid container dark brown plastic together.
Use each arm to grab the medium-sized drink bottle and the medium bottle.
Grab the yellow rectangular bottle and grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom at once.
Pick up the liquid container dark brown plastic and take the orange bottle with smooth texture together.
Use each arm to grab the brown bottle and the bottle with ridged neck.
Pick up the bottle with rounded edges with one arm, grab the liquid container dark brown plastic with the other.
Grab the brown bottle and grab the medium bottle for liquids at once.
Grab the bottle with red screw cap with one arm, grab the plastic soda bottle with the other.
Grab the hand-sized yellow plastic bottle and the bottle with attached loop on cap at the same time.
Use each arm to grab the bottle with curved neck design and the bottle with yellow sticker label.
Grab the smooth bottle with blue text with one arm, grab the lightweight plastic brown bottle with the other.
Grab the medium bottle for liquids with one arm, grab the glossy brown bottle with the other.
Grab the bottle with attached loop on cap and the plastic orange bottle with rounded base at the same time.
Grab the curvy yellow plastic bottle and grab the brown bottle at once.
Grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom with one arm, grab the bottle with ridges near base with the other.
Grab the medium-sized plastic bottle with capped top with one arm, grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom with the other.
Grab the plastic orange bottle with rounded base with one arm, grab the smooth blue water bottle with the other.
Pick up the bottle with white cap and take the curvy orange bottle with white section together.
